notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Hey!
Couple fixes.
-Brighter lasers from the white drones.
-Reduced bunching of the buzz drones
-slightly different formula on the grappling hook launch.
-other fixes

If you see some bugs let me know specifically what they are please! 

Currently working on the next level which is like a mining facility on a planet with giant metal crystals. If you have any ideas on what the boss should be let me know.

Thanks,
Ryan

notes.title: First demo update
notes.content:
Hey everyone,
Thank you for all the support so far! Its been amazing. Just pushed a small update to the demo and started implementing suggestions into the final game.

Updates:
-Got rid of the loud engine sound in the start menu.
-Made it so you can't jump out of the start map.

Please let me know if you have any problems with the new build, its taking a while to update on my end so hopefully it works once it goes live haha.
Ill post some new footage of improvements soon!

-Ryan
